title: Antibacterial and electrical performance of triboelectric nanogenerators based on polyhexamethylene guanidine hydrochloride in high humidity environments
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18237-18244
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02735G, Paper

Doan T. Tung, Hoang T. Dung, Le T. T. Tam, Bui V. Cuong, Ha M. Dung, Duong V. Dat, Ngo T. Dung, Nguyen T. Dung, Phan N. Minh, Le T. Lu
A novel TENG based on a PHMG–CS film as the positive electrode demonstrates high output efficiency, excellent humidity resistance, and antibacterial efficacy, making it ideal for self-powered wearable electronic and hygienic surface applications.
